## What Biograph is

Biograph ("fossibleHIS", by Tacten / Fossible Works) is an open-source **hospital information system (HIS)**. It is a fork of Marley Health (earthians/biograph) with added features. It is a **Frappe app** (`app_name = "healthcare"`, `app_title = "Biograph"`) that adds the health domain to **ERPNext**, and ERPNext is a hard dependency (`required_apps = ["frappe/erpnext"]`). Much of the data model follows **HL7 FHIR** (ServiceRequest, Observation, DiagnosticReport, code systems).

## Who uses it

- **Clinic and hospital staff** use the Frappe Desk (`/desk/healthcare`). This includes practitioners, nurses, front desk, lab, pharmacy and billing staff. The desk workspaces are Healthcare, Outpatient, Inpatient, Diagnostics, Rehabilitation, Insurance and Setup.
- **Patients** use the Patient Portal (`/patient-portal`, Vue SPA) and web forms (lab tests, prescriptions, appointments, personal details).

## Key feature areas

- Patient management, including duplicate-patient detection rules.
- Outpatient: Patient Appointment (slot-based and block-time booking, recurring appointments, practitioner unavailability), Patient Encounter, Fee Validity.
- Inpatient: Inpatient Record, medication orders/entries, service-unit occupancy billing.
- Clinical Procedures, Lab Test / Sample Collection, Observation / Diagnostic Report.
- Rehabilitation / Physiotherapy: Therapy Plan, Therapy Session, Exercise Types.
- Insurance: Insurance Payor, Patient Insurance Coverage, Insurance Claim.
- Medical Code Standards / code systems, Service Units as a tree, Medical Departments.
- Billing goes through ERPNext Sales Invoice / Payment Entry, which this app extends via hooks.
- India regional: ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) integration under `healthcare/regional/india/abdm`.

Install with `bench get-app <repo>` and then `bench --site <site> install-app healthcare`.
